release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.7

- Strict Private Meetings: When scheduling a meeting for selected members, only the invited participants and the host can view and join the call. Non-invited users are strictly blocked.
- Selective Calling & Auto-Ringing: Incoming call rings are sent ONLY to the selected participants for both manual rings and automated meeting alerts.
- Direct Cumulative Updates: Seamless one-step update directly to the newest version from any previous version.
- Instant Community Directory: Fast offline caching and real-time search by registration name.
- WebRTC & Call Security: Upgraded Agora AccessToken2 credentials and audio/video stability.
